verdict.rationale: Daytona is API-first: sandboxes, snapshots, volumes, network limits, and even computer-use/GUI automation are all exposed via SDKs (Python/TS), CLI, and a documented OpenAPI spec, with an MCP server enabling agents to drive everything programmatically. The web terminal/UI appears to be a thin convenience layer over the same programmatic primitives, consistent with an API-native product built for AI agents.
